description: Change the user's saved profile: the preferences (roles, skills, seniority, languages, location) and the headline and summary text shown on their profile page. This changes their account, so say what you are about to change and get the user's agreement first. Call get_profile first. Send only the fields that change; a field you leave out stays as it is, and a list you send REPLACES the stored one (use add_skills to add without touching the rest). Skills are matched against freehire's skill dictionary; any it does not know are NOT saved and come back in not_in_dictionary — offer to call suggest_dictionary_term for those. Headline and summary are cut to the profile page's length limits, and the result names any field that was cut in truncated. The result lists which fields were saved and, if some failed, which were not. This changes the profile, not a CV document: the documents sent to employers are edited with cv_edit.

add_skills.description: Skills to add to the stored list. Cannot be combined with skills.

excluded_skills.description: Skills to avoid. Replaces the stored list; a skill that is also wanted is dropped from it.

headline.description: The profile headline, one line (for example a role and level). Sent as an empty string it is cleared.

job_languages.description: Two-letter codes of the languages vacancies may be written in.

location_preferences.description: Where and how they will work. Replaces the whole block, so send every part that should stay. Read it from get_profile first.

countries.description: ISO country codes they would move to.

regions.description: Regions: global, north_america, latam, eu, uk, mena, africa, apac, cis.

seniorities.description: Levels wanted: intern, junior, middle, senior, lead, staff, principal, c_level.

skills.description: The full list of skills wanted. Replaces the stored list.

specializations.description: Job categories wanted, from the specialization vocabulary (see facets).

summary.description: The profile summary, a short paragraph about who they are professionally. Sent as an empty string it is cleared.

name: update_profile
title: Update my job-search profile
